citation: Ricklefs, R. E. (2008), The Economy of Nature, figure 5.5; digitized by Valentin Stefan, plotbiomes
conversion: pyreadr to CSV, original vertex order and float precision retained. Source precipitation in cm; classifier converts to mm.
method: Point in digitized biome polygons; shared edges choose lowest ID; outside polygons remain unclassified. Climate potential, not an observed vegetation map.
